scenes.title: Eighteen Hundred Videos and Counting
scenes.summary: In 1990, Muranishi introduces himself to a documentary interviewer as the tireless force behind eighteen hundred films in a fifty-billion-yen entertainment industry.

scenes.title: Creative Soulmates on Camera
scenes.summary: Kuroki and Muranishi praise each other's boundless talent before Muranishi turns the tables on his startled female interviewer and playfully tries to cast her.

scenes.title: Kickstarting the Year 1990
scenes.summary: Kawada hands out cash advances and keeps daily logistics moving while Muranishi rallies his bustling crew for the start of 1990.

scenes.title: Crashing the Street Campaign
scenes.summary: Muranishi and Kuroki pull up to a crowded Tokyo political rally atop their own campaign van, preaching freedom and lower crime rates to stunned onlookers.

scenes.title: Handcuffs After the Speech
scenes.summary: Detective Takei arrives at the rally, poses as a supporter until Kuroki finishes her speech, and arrests Muranishi over an underage cast member.

scenes.title: A Pocket Envelope and Quick Release
scenes.summary: Kawada visits a top prosecutor to explain how lookalike sisters fooled their ID check and slips him cash, freeing Muranishi right in front of furious detectives.
scenes.location: traditional parlor and Tokyo police station

scenes.title: Takei Joins the Regulation Board
scenes.summary: Over lunch with Kawada and the chain Proprietor, Takei announces his post-retirement move to the video regulation commission and warns Muranishi to behave.

scenes.title: A Pitch About Space Satellites
scenes.summary: A bank Section Chief calls Muranishi with an exciting pitch about satellite broadcasting in space, secretly planning to hook him for five hundred million yen.

scenes.title: Giant Dishes Pointed at the Sky
scenes.summary: Standing beneath massive parabolic antennas that beam television signals to orbit and back, Muranishi tells the banker to move forward at full speed.

scenes.title: Ten Seconds at the Helipad
scenes.summary: At a helipad, the satellite company President brushes off the banker's introduction, leaving the banker to explain the President's licensing power to Muranishi.

scenes.title: Dazzling the Television Producers
scenes.summary: Kuroki impresses a literary talk-show host and studio producers with her articulate views on shame and censorship before heading out for steak with Muranishi.

scenes.title: Freedom Showering From Space
scenes.summary: Late at night, Muranishi excitedly tells Kuroki about the giant satellite antennas that could beam uncensored films freely to the entire world.

scenes.title: A Ringing Pager and an Evening Meeting
scenes.summary: Right after smashing a crewman's noisy pager during a take, Muranishi answers his own cell phone when the banker calls with an appointment to meet the satellite President.

scenes.title: Barging Into the Mansion Party
scenes.summary: Kept waiting over tea while the satellite President plays video games, Muranishi storms into the room to demand a channel and boasts of five billion yen in annual sales.

scenes.title: Remember the Name Toru Muranishi
scenes.summary: Mocked by three-hundred-billion-yen tycoons who know Kuroki's name but not his, Muranishi vows they will remember him and buys the banker's luxury properties for satellite advice.
scenes.location: luxury mansion and nighttime Tokyo street
